nodes.label: Decision: Gemini Rather Than Anthropic for the Reasoning Core
nodes.rationale: Access and cost. Kept behind lib/llm.ts so the architecture described in the proposal — an LLM reasoning core with native tool use — is unchanged regardless of vendor; also makes a mid-week provider swap a one-file change.
nodes.norm_label: decision: gemini rather than anthropic for the reasoning core

nodes.label: Decision: Online/Supabase Rather Than Local Postgres
nodes.rationale: Components are interconnected; an offline build would harness less capability. Mitigated by a phone hotspot as primary connectivity and a recorded real run as fallback.
nodes.norm_label: decision: online/supabase rather than local postgres

nodes.label: Decision: Gmail Live, Other Four Tool Categories Simulated
nodes.rationale: One genuinely live integration proves the pattern; four fragile OAuth integrations would risk the demo. Disclosed openly to judges rather than hidden.
nodes.norm_label: decision: gmail live, other four tool categories simulated

nodes.label: Decision: Gmail OAuth Pulled Forward to Day 1
nodes.rationale: Pulled forward three days before it is needed because Google's consent screen setup eats time unpredictably.
nodes.norm_label: decision: gmail oauth pulled forward to day 1

nodes.label: Decision: manualProcedure Added on Day 4
nodes.rationale: Costs half a day, directly answers the sponsor's stated thesis, and sits inside the proposal's existing promise that reasoning is attached to every action so approval is informed rather than rubber-stamp. Not a deviation.

nodes.label: Decision: Hard Code Freeze 6pm Day 7
nodes.rationale: A feature added the night before a demo is the most common way hackathon teams lose on stage.

nodes.label: Non-Negotiable Rule 1: Real Function Calling Only
nodes.rationale: An LLM that writes tool names as text is not tool use; it must go through native function-calling and dispatch real functions. This exact bug shipped once on 21 July and was caught late.
nodes.norm_label: non-negotiable rule 1: real function calling only

nodes.label: Non-Negotiable Rule 2: Every Tool Call Persists a trail_steps Row
nodes.rationale: As it happens, not batched at the end — this table is the audit trail judges click through; failed calls are logged too.
nodes.norm_label: non-negotiable rule 2: every tool call persists a trail_steps row

nodes.label: Non-Negotiable Rule 3: Every Decision Carries manualProcedure
nodes.rationale: Must read like a colleague teaching you the judgment, not a log of what happened — the sponsor wants an operator who can learn the process by watching and replicate it without the agent.
nodes.norm_label: non-negotiable rule 3: every decision carries manualprocedure

nodes.label: Non-Negotiable Rule 4: The Agent Must Know When It Doesn't Know
nodes.rationale: Below the confidence threshold, route to ask_human rather than guessing; escalation message is structured (tried/found/unresolved/options/recommendation), never a bare 'I don't know.'
nodes.norm_label: non-negotiable rule 4: the agent must know when it doesn't know

nodes.label: Non-Negotiable Rule 5: Tool Selection Is Not a Fixed Sequence
nodes.rationale: The agent chooses which tools to call per case; a routine reminder might touch two, reconciliation should touch four. If the sequence is hardcoded, the side-by-side demo dies.
nodes.norm_label: non-negotiable rule 5: tool selection is not a fixed sequence

nodes.label: Decision: Provider Change Anthropic → Google Gemini (Cost Grounds)
nodes.rationale: Decided 23 July on cost grounds: Gemini API is free at the tier needed, Anthropic API usage across a week of iteration was not viable. Loop logic, trail capture, outcome memory, prompts and seeded data are all untouched.
nodes.norm_label: decision: provider change anthropic → google gemini (cost grounds)

nodes.label: Risk: Phase 1 Proposal Names Anthropic/Claude Explicitly
nodes.rationale: If named in the architecture section, a provider swap is a visible deviation and disqualifying; mitigation is checking the PDF and emailing organisers for written confirmation before Day 1. The only disqualifying risk on the board if unresolved.
nodes.norm_label: risk: phase 1 proposal names anthropic/claude explicitly

nodes.label: Risk: Gemini Free-Tier Rate Limits (429s Mid-Run)
nodes.rationale: A five-invoice run makes ~15-20 API calls; free tier caps requests per minute. A 4-6 second delay between turns must exist before the first full run or the Day 0 gate looks like a code failure when it is a quota failure.
nodes.norm_label: risk: gemini free-tier rate limits (429s mid-run)

nodes.label: The Differentiator: Every Decision Renders as a Teachable Procedure
nodes.rationale: Every other team will build an agent that calls APIs and renders results on a dashboard — precisely the pattern the sponsor named as the problem. ORBIT's bet is to be the only team whose decisions read as a teachable procedure, not just a result; costs roughly half a day and is the single highest-leverage half-day in the plan.
nodes.norm_label: the differentiator: every decision renders as a teachable procedure

nodes.label: Risk: Loop Does Not Run on Day 0 (Critical)
nodes.rationale: Hard gate tonight; if it fails, replan Day 1 morning rather than proceeding on assumption.
nodes.norm_label: risk: loop does not run on day 0 (critical)

nodes.label: Risk: Migration Consumes the Whole of Day 0 (High)
nodes.rationale: Write lib/llm.ts first so the boundary is clean; if it overruns, Day 1 morning finishes it and Gmail OAuth slips to Day 2 — MVP checkpoint still holds.
nodes.norm_label: risk: migration consumes the whole of day 0 (high)

nodes.label: Risk: Venue Network Fails (High)
nodes.rationale: Hotspot as primary, tested with Supabase specifically. Recorded real run as final fallback.

nodes.label: Risk: Gmail OAuth Consumes Days (High)
nodes.rationale: Pulled forward to Day 1, three days before it is needed.

nodes.label: Risk: Only Tharusha Can Explain the Code (High)
nodes.rationale: Mansi reads the loop from Day 0; every file has a named owner; all four rehearse Q&A.
nodes.norm_label: risk: only tharusha can explain the code (high)

nodes.label: Risk: Quota Exhausted During the Live Demo (High)
nodes.rationale: Free-tier daily caps are shared per project. Have a second Google account and key ready as a hot spare, avoid burning quota on morning rehearsals.
nodes.norm_label: risk: quota exhausted during the live demo (high)

nodes.label: Risk: Feature Creep in the Final 48 Hours (Medium)
nodes.rationale: Hard code freeze 6pm Day 7. Only crash fixes after.
nodes.norm_label: risk: feature creep in the final 48 hours (medium)

nodes.label: Risk: Judges Read Simulated Tools as Fake (Medium)
nodes.rationale: State it plainly and unprompted, before being asked; emphasise the agent genuinely chooses and executes the simulated tools.
nodes.norm_label: risk: judges read simulated tools as fake (medium)

nodes.label: Risk: Demo Runs Long (Medium)
nodes.rationale: Time three rehearsals; know which two segments can be dropped without breaking the narrative.

nodes.label: Risk: Someone Becomes Unavailable (Medium)
nodes.rationale: Two people can run the agent from Day 0. Push to GitHub nightly, no exceptions.
